study: Recording-separated and frame-separated confirmation of frozen Qwen with four-scale physical completion
candidate: C_E_Qsize from publication 776c982aa54636907b9c2afd99b2fd97d6597dea. The locked prior code uses an independent Qwen 2D query, full-scene four-scale geometry, the original match score and fallback, selected component PCA, Qwen dimensions, and visible-face and bottom anchoring. No 3EED weights in this candidate.
selection: Round-robin stable hash over recordings of the sealed Ordinary Validation roster, then over physical frame keys, then over utterance rows. Waymo excludes all development recordings and groups the five views by timestamp. Drone and Quad validation share recording identities with development and exclude its physical frames. The separate Drone and Quad recording extension uses only the existing R159 sealed Ordinary TRAIN roster on non-validation recordings. Across both panels exclude development and evaluation duplicates by physical key, raw point digest and RGB digest. Original unmodified captions for the two Qwen calls; historical 3EED canonical formatting for v3. No coordinates, classes, model outputs or target scores used for selection.
comparison: A is Qwen original window median. B is registered v3 on the same observation from both incoming source checkpoints, with each source scored independently. On Validation verify the historical replay per row. H is locked C_E_Qsize. Report all physical frames for Qwen and both directional rows per frame for B, with equal target weight and equal incoming source weight per target. Separate the Validation, new recording subset, same-recording subset, and Ordinary TRAIN extension. No target-dependent selection or model updates. All failed parses and fallbacks remain in task denominators.
orientation: When the locked region is valid, preserve its identity, candidate center and all dimensions. Express both boxes with length first and replace only the axial yaw with Qwen's converted long-axis yaw. Separately report the previously evaluated Qwen-yaw reanchored box. Compute axial yaw error and IoU on the matched region subset, and an offline specificity subset with ground-truth length/width >= 1.2 and at least half the region points inside the target box expanded by 5 cm. Full task scores always include all fallbacks. Describe paired association of horizontal eigenvalue gap, azimuth coverage and deterministic PCA instability with yaw-induced IoU differences. Measure rank AUC for choosing the better yaw, within platform and recording, using strict comparisons, not a fitted rule. No selector is run or selected on this panel.
physics: Repeat the fit-only region, all-window, and same-window matched-count mismatch completion controls. Fit-tree construction excludes every draw belonging to a withheld raw 4x4 pixel cell, also applying the existing model-coordinate parity exclusion. Check all removals using original draw indices. Fit-only terrain and all three measured boxes use fitting observations. Evaluate first-hit depths and misses on held-out rays, comparing common-hit depth MAE and reporting hit coverage. Keep full-region task performance separate from the held-out-ray inference.
metrics: Strict oriented IoU > .25 and > .50, mIoU, paired rescue/harm and recording resampling intervals. Score only after sealing. Report the primary Validation contrast against A and every target, replica contrast to B, and aligned orientation and geometry contrasts. Retain positive and negative tails. A positive locked candidate on recording-separated data supports continued work; conflicting platform results limit any general claim.
